description: Commercial feedback shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 in verified available funds and CAD 0 in verified revenue. The tested SQLite download gives us an existing product to offer, so the next step is to check whether Ko-fi can support a Canadian seller and a paid download. One recent fetch returned HTTP 403, which leaves the relevant terms unresolved. Seller activation depends on readable terms and an authorized operator. A supported route would justify a private listing draft, with independent review before any public deployment.
